_comment: Callee stack/x87 effects for the frame walk of 009BFEE0 (plane follow geometry step).
Packet cc8_follow_steer, 2026-09-19. Feed to tools/x87trace.py, which starts with an
EMPTY call table: with no --call/--icall it assumes every call is esp+0 / depth+0 and
its ESP walk is junk (15 join conflicts). With this table the walk is globally
ESP-consistent over 009BFEE0-009C1846 (every remaining conflict agrees at esp -140;
esp_effect is the CALLER-side effect and equals exactly the callee's own RET imm.
A tail `pop ecx` in these callees is MSVC's 4-byte local allocation being freed, NOT
argument cleanup - internal push/pop balance, so they contribute nothing here.
tools/calleefx.py sweeps linearly until INT3 padding and OVERRUNS into the next
function when there is none; where it reported two RET imms the real body end comes
from Ghidra and the imm was read as bytes at that end. Those cases are marked
x87_push is +1 when the callee leaves a float in ST0.

0042cf10.name: BSP_Geometry_AsinClamped
0042cf10.note: RET 4, not RET 0: calleefx's ret 0 at 0042cfb3 is the NEXT function. 7 call sites.

0042be90.name: FUN_0042be90
0042be90.note: negates via [00d7a208] = -0.0f; tail pop ecx is local alloc

00415510.name: BSP_Math_MinFloatByRef
00415510.note: float __fastcall(float*, float*): both args in ECX/EDX, no stack args

00419010.name: BSP_Math_InterpolateClamped
00419010.note: RET 14h (=20) confirmed: 004190ce is c2 14 00. calleefx's ret 0x10 at 00419138 is the NEXT function.

00bf701a.name: LIBCRT_atan2
00bf701a.note: atan2, NOT sqrt - a separate entry that the sqrt span swallowed. cdecl.

0042e740.name: BSP_GameTuning_GetSingleton
0042e740.note: add esp,0x18 / ret. calleefx's ret 4 at 0042e82e is the NEXT function.

009c00c8.note: 0 stack args; FSTP straight after -> float return

009c01b6.note: 0 stack args; FSTP straight after -> float return

009c025e.note: one pushed out-pointer (lea eax,[esp+68h]); returns that pointer in EAX, caller FLDs [eax]

x87trace_note: x87trace.py parses --call addr:xpush:retimm with int(retimm) base 10, so RET 14h is written 20 and RET 0Ch is 12. Its `base [ESP+NNh]` annotation is the canonical frame slot (base = disp - fb + basefb, basefb default 0x58) and is what makes ESP-relative slots comparable across the body.
